requested_titles: List of Power Moons in the Wooded Kingdom
title: List of Power Moons in the Wooded Kingdom
wikitext:
{{construction}} This is a list of the 76 [[Power Moon]]s that can be found in the [[Wooded Kingdom]] of ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. {|class="wikitable" text-align="center" !# !Power Moon !Location !Availability |- !1 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 1.png|200px]]
[[Road to Sky Garden]] |The player must traverse through the Iron Road and then defeat the [[Big Poison Piranha Plant]] at the end in order to receive this Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !2 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 2.png|200px]]
[[Flower Thieves of Sky Garden]] |The player will receive a Multi Moon after defeating [[Spewart]] on the Sky Garden Tower. |Available after collecting the "Road to Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !3 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 3.png|200px]]
Path to the Secret Flower Field |The player must head to the Secret Flower Field and then destroy the cannon blocking the entrance using the nearby [[Sherm]]s. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !4 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 4.png|200px]]
Defend the Secret Flower Field! |The player will receive a Multi Moon after defeating [[Torkdrift]] in the Secret Flower Field. |Available after collecting the "Path to the Secret Flower Field" Power Moon. |- !5 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 5.png|200px]]
Behind the Rock Wall |Near the Summit Path checkpoint, the player can find a Sherm next to a rock wall. Mario must capture the Sherm and then destroy the top-left corner of the rock wall in order to reveal a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !6 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 6.png|200px]]
Back Way Up the Mountain |Near the Iron Mountain Path, Station 8 checkpoint, the player can find a low platform with an [[Uproot]] and some [[Rock Block]]s. Mario must capture the Uproot and use him to destroy the Rock Blocks located in the corner in order to find a hidden passage with an [[8-Bit Pipe]]. If the player reaches the end of the 8-bit section here, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !7 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 7.png|200px]]
Rolling Rock in the Woods |Near the Odyssey, the player can find a rock between four bushes. If Mario destroys this rock, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !8 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 8.png|200px]]
Caught Hopping in the Forest! |Near the Odyssey, the player can find a rabbit. If Mario catches the rabbit, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !9 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 9.png|200px]]
Thanks for the Charge! |At the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a glowing spot on the right-most charging station. If Mario ground pounds this spot, a Power Moon will appear. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !10 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 10.png|200px]]
Atop the Tall Tree |In the south-eastern corner of the kingdom, the player can find an Uproot next to a tall tree. Mario must capture the Uproot and use it to climb up the tall tree, where a nut can be found. If the player destroys the nut, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !11 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 11.png|200px]]
Tucked Away Inside the Tunnel |In the south-eastern corner of the kingdom, the player can find an Uproot next to a tall tree. Mario must capture the Uproot and then return to the river in the opening area of the kingdom. The player must then head upstream and locate a nut located high up on a wall. Using the Uproot, Mario can reach the nut and destroy it, revealing a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !12 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 12.png|200px]]
Over the Cliff's Edge |Near the Summit Path checkpoint, the player should look for a hidden path behind the cliff wall. If Mario traverses this path, he will find a nut, which will reward a Power Moon when destroyed. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !13 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 13.png|200px]]
The Nut 'Round the Corner |Before reaching the Iron Road: Entrance checkpoint, the player should look for a hidden iron path near [[Talkatoo]]. Mario should traverse this hidden path to find a nut, which will reward a Power Moon once destroyed. |Available from the start. |- !14 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 14.png|200px]]
Climb the Cliff to Get the Nut |From the start of the kingdom, the player should look for the river and follow its path upstream. At the top end of the river, the player will find a cave with a lever and and door. If Mario activates the lever (by throwing [[Cappy]] at it), the door will open, allowing him to access a hidden cliffside with an Uproot. Mario should capture the Uproot and use it to climb up the cliffside and find a hidden nut. Destroying the nut will reward the player with a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !15 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 15.png|200px]]
The Nut in the Red Maze |While traversing through the Iron Road, the player should look for a nut hidden in a corner of the maze. If Mario destroys this nut, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !16 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 16.png|200px]]
The Nut at the Dead End |From the "Road to Sky Garden" Power Moon, the player should locate a hidden iron path located underneath that Power Moon's location. If Mario reaches the end of this hidden path, he will find a nut that will reward him with a secret Power Moon once destroyed. |Available from the start. |- !17 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 17.png|200px]]
Cracked Nut on a Crumbling Tower |Between the Iron Road: Halfway Point and the Sky Garden Tower, the player can find a side path made of collapsing platforms. If Mario can traverse these platforms and reach the end of their path, he will find a nut, which will reward a Power Moon once destroyed. |Available after collecting the "Road to Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !18 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 18.png|200px]]
The Nut that Grew on the Tall Fence |Near the Iron Mountain Path, Station 8 checkpoint, the player should head across the nearby iron wall to find a hidden nut, which will reward a Power Moon once destroyed. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !19 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 19.png|200px]]
Fire in the Cave |From the Iron Road: Entrance checkpoint, the player should head through an opening between some iron bars along the left side, where a scarecrow can be found. Mario must throw Cappy at the scarecrow, which will open the nearby door and allow access to the cave behind. In the cave, the player must defeat the [[Fire Bro]], which will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !20 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 20.png|200px]]
Hey Out There, Captain Toad! |From the Observation Deck, the player must capture [[Glydon]] and use him to glide to a distant island to the east. On this island, Mario can find [[Captain Toad]], who will give the player a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !21 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 21.png|200px]]
Love in the Forest Ruins |Near the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a field of [[Goomba]]s. Mario must capture one of the Goombas and then use it to create a Goomba Tower, which can be used to reach [[Goombette]], who is located on a high platform nearby. If the player uses the Goomba Tower to interact with Goombette, she will give the player a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !22 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 22.png|200px]]
Inside a Rock in the Forest |Near the Summit Path checkpoint, the player can find a Sherm on a lower cliff platform. Mario must capture the Sherm and then head back near the Odyssey, where a dirt rock can be found. If the player destroys this dirt rock, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !23 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 23.png|200px]]
Shopping in Steam Gardens |The player can purchase a Power Moon from the [[Crazy Cap]] Shop for 100 yellow [[Coin]]s. |Available from the start. |- !24 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 24.png|200px]]
Nut Planted in the Tower |Inside the Sky Garden Tower, the player can find a nut planted on the central column. If Mario destroys this nut, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Road to Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !25 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 25.png|200px]]
Stretching Your Legs |Inside the Sky Garden Tower, Mario must capture an Uproot and take it to the top of the central column. At the top, the player must stretch the Uproot in order to reach a Power Moon located high above. |Available after collecting the "Road to Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !26 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 26.png|200px]]
Spinning-Platforms Treasure |Near the Secret Flower Field, the player should look off the eastern cliff edge to find some hidden iron platforms below. Mario must jump down to these platforms and then traverse across the rotating platforms here in order to reach a Warp Pipe, which will take the player to a secret room containing a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !27 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 27.png|200px]]
Make the Secret Flower Field Bloom |Within the Secret Flower Field, the player can find three groups of un-bloomed flowers. Mario must throw Cappy at all three groups of flowers in order to bloom them all (before they un-bloom) within a short amount of time. If the player blooms all the flowers, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !28 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 28.png|200px]]
Rolling Rock in the Deep Woods |At the southern end of the Deep Woods, Mario can find a rock that he can break. If the player can break this rock, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !29 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 29.png|200px]]
Glowing in the Deep Woods |In the Deep Woods, the player can find a scarecrow near the pool of the river. Mario must throw Cappy at the scarecrow, which will cause a Power Moon to temporarily spawn nearby. The player must then collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available from the start. |- !30 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 30.png|200px]]
Past the Peculiar Pipes |Along the eastern wall of the Deep Woods, the player can find a Warp Pipe, which will take Mario to a small pipe maze. If the player can successfully traverse through the pipe maze, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !31 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 31.png|200px]]
By the Babbling Brook in Deep Woods |In the Deep Woods, the player can find a [[T-Rex]] roaming around. If Mario can lure the T-Rex to charge into a solid wall, it will get knocked out, allowing Mario to capture it. The player must then take it to the north-western corner of the Deep Woods (left of the river's origin) and use it to destroy the large rock here. This will reveal a glowing spot on the ground, which Mario can ground pound to reveal a hidden Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !32 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 32.png|200px]]
The Hard Rock in Deep Woods |In the Deep Woods, the player can find a [[T-Rex]] roaming around. If Mario can lure the T-Rex to charge into a solid wall, it will get knocked out, allowing Mario to capture it. The player must then take it to the south-eastern corner of the Deep Woods (right of the river's end) and use it to destroy the large rock here. This will reveal a glowing spot on the ground, which Mario can ground pound to reveal a hidden Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !33 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 33.png|200px]]
A Treasure Made from Coins |In the Deep Woods, the player should look for a hidden [[Coin Coffer]] on a small hill. Mario must capture the Coin Coffer and then take it to the pool of the river. Here, the player can find a small plant sprout surrounded by coins. Mario must shoot the sprout with about 700 coins in order to have it fully bloom into a flower, which will give the player a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !34 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 34.png|200px]]
Beneath the Roots of the Moving Tree |Along the eastern wall of the Deep Woods, the player can find a small [[Tree|pine tree]]. If the player captures the tree, they can move it out of the way to reveal a glowing spot on the floor. Mario must then ground pound the glowing spot to reveal a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !35 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 35.png|200px]]
Deep Woods Treasure Trap |Near the southern end of the Deep Woods, the player can find a Warp Pipe coming out of a large tree. Mario must enter the pipe to find a room with tree treasure chests. If the player opens them in the correct order (center, left, right), they will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !36 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 36.png|200px]]
Exploring for Treasure |At the northern end of the Deep Woods (where the river's origin is located), the player can find a locked door being guarded by a Steam Gardener. In order to enter this door, the player needs to wear both the Explorer outfit and the Explorer hat. Once Mario enters the room, he can find a treasure chest in the center of the room. Opening it will reward the player with a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !37 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 37.png|200px]]
Wooded Kingdom Timer Challenge 1 |Next to the Iron Road: Halfway Point checkpoint, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some poles and a Power Moon above them. The player must then swing up the poles and collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !38 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 38.png|200px]]
Wooded Kingdom Timer Challenge 2 |At the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a scarecrow on the left-most charging station. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some platforms and a Power Moon above them. The player must then jump up the platforms and collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !39 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 39.png|200px]]
Flooding Pipeway |Near the Iron Road: Entrance, the player can find a pool of water with a submerged Warp Pipe. Mario should enter this Warp Pipe and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !40 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 40.png|200px]]
Flooding Pipeway Ceiling Secret |In the area with the "Flooding Pipeway" Power Moon, the player should look for an opening in the ceiling. Mario must enter this opening in order to find a small alcove with a hidden Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !41 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 41.png|200px]]
Wandering in the Fog |Near the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a Mini Rocket on an iron platform. Mario should capture the rocket to be taken to a secret area covered in fog, where he must find and collect five [[Moon Shard]]s. If he can collect them all, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !42 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 42.png|200px]]
Nut Hidden in the Fog |In the area with the "Wandering in the Fog" Power Moon, the player can find a nut hidden behind an iron platform on the northern side of the area. If Mario destroys this nut, he will receive a secret Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !43 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 43.png|200px]]
Flower Road Run |From the Summit Path checkpoint, the player should head to the back side of the large sloped ramp, where a hidden door can be found. Mario must enter this door and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !44 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 44.png|200px]]
Flower Road Reach |In the area with the "Flower Road Run" Power Moon, the player must capture a Goomba and then use it to create a Goomba Tower. This will allow Mario to reach the hidden Power Moon located on a high iron platform that he could otherwise not reach. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !45 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 45.png|200px]]
Elevator Escalation |At the Summit Path checkpoint, the player should locate a hidden door at the top-right side of the large sloped ramp. Mario should enter this door and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to find a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !46 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 46.png|200px]]
Elevator Blind Spot |In the area with the "Elevator Escalation" Power Moon, the player must capture a Sherm at the start of the area and then use it to shoot and destroy a hidden rock located on the back wall. This will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !47 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 47.png|200px]]
Walking on Clouds |Near the Secret Flower Field Entrance, the player can find a Steam Gardener that will give a seed once activated. Mario must then carry this seed to the large seed pot on the Observation Deck. This will take him to a secret area in the clouds. If the player reaches the end of this area, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !48 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 48.png|200px]]
Above the Clouds |In the area with the "Walking on Clouds" Power Moon, the player must capture an Uproot at the start of the area and use it to reach a hidden Power Moon located high above the platform in the center of the area. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !49 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 49.png|200px]]
Secret Path to the Steam Gardens! |This Power Moon can be found inside the Iron Cage. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: *If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom before the [[Lake Kingdom]] and visits the Snow Kingdom after the Seaside Kingdom, then the painting can be found on a high cliff ledge at the north end of the starting area in the [[Snow Kingdom]]. *If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom before the Lake Kingdom and visits the Seaside Kingdom after the Snow Kingdom, then the painting can be found inside the Crystal Palace at the center of the [[Seaside Kingdom]]. *If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom after the Lake Kingdom, then the painting can be found a ledge hidden directly behind the Odyssey in the [[Metro Kingdom]]. |Available after collecting the "The Bound Bowl Grand Prix" Power Moon (Snow Kingdom).

Available after collecting the "The Glass Is Half Full!" Power Moon (Seaside Kingdom).

Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon (Metro Kingdom). |- !50 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 50.png|200px]]
Found with Wooded Kingdom Art |Near the Odyssey, the player should look for a picture of the Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Trace-Walking mini-game in the Sand Kingdom, along with two bushes north of his location. If the player then returns to the Sand Kingdom, locates these two bushes and ground pounds next to them, they will be rewarded with a hidden Power Moon. |Available from the start. |} {{SMO}} [[Category:Lists|Wooded Kingdom Power Moons]] [[Category:Super Mario Odyssey]]

Shopping in Steam Gardens |The player can purchase a Power Moon from the [[Crazy Cap]] Shop for 100 yellow [[Coin]]s. |Available from the start. |- !24 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 24.png|200px]]
Nut Planted in the Tower |Inside the Sky Garden Tower, the player can find a nut planted on the central column. If Mario destroys this nut, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Road to Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !25 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 25.png|200px]]
Stretching Your Legs |Inside the Sky Garden Tower, Mario must capture an Uproot and take it to the top of the central column. At the top, the player must stretch the Uproot in order to reach a Power Moon located high above. |Available after collecting the "Road to Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !26 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 26.png|200px]]
Spinning-Platforms Treasure |Near the Secret Flower Field, the player should look off the eastern cliff edge to find some hidden iron platforms below. Mario must jump down to these platforms and then traverse across the rotating platforms here in order to reach a Warp Pipe, which will take the player to a secret room containing a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !27 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 27.png|200px]]
Make the Secret Flower Field Bloom |Within the Secret Flower Field, the player can find three groups of un-bloomed flowers. Mario must throw Cappy at all three groups of flowers in order to bloom them all (before they un-bloom) within a short amount of time. If the player blooms all the flowers, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !28 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 28.png|200px]]
Rolling Rock in the Deep Woods |At the southern end of the Deep Woods, Mario can find a rock that he can break. If the player can break this rock, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !29 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 29.png|200px]]
Glowing in the Deep Woods |In the Deep Woods, the player can find a scarecrow near the pool of the river. Mario must throw Cappy at the scarecrow, which will cause a Power Moon to temporarily spawn nearby. The player must then collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available from the start. |- !30 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 30.png|200px]]
Past the Peculiar Pipes |Along the eastern wall of the Deep Woods, the player can find a Warp Pipe, which will take Mario to a small pipe maze. If the player can successfully traverse through the pipe maze, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !31 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 31.png|200px]]
By the Babbling Brook in Deep Woods |In the Deep Woods, the player can find a [[T-Rex]] roaming around. If Mario can lure the T-Rex to charge into a solid wall, it will get knocked out, allowing Mario to capture it. The player must then take it to the north-western corner of the Deep Woods (left of the river's origin) and use it to destroy the large rock here. This will reveal a glowing spot on the ground, which Mario can ground pound to reveal a hidden Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !32 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 32.png|200px]]
The Hard Rock in Deep Woods |In the Deep Woods, the player can find a [[T-Rex]] roaming around. If Mario can lure the T-Rex to charge into a solid wall, it will get knocked out, allowing Mario to capture it. The player must then take it to the south-eastern corner of the Deep Woods (right of the river's end) and use it to destroy the large rock here. This will reveal a glowing spot on the ground, which Mario can ground pound to reveal a hidden Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !33 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 33.png|200px]]
A Treasure Made from Coins |In the Deep Woods, the player should look for a hidden [[Coin Coffer]] on a small hill. Mario must capture the Coin Coffer and then take it to the pool of the river. Here, the player can find a small plant sprout surrounded by coins. Mario must shoot the sprout with about 700 coins in order to have it fully bloom into a flower, which will give the player a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !34 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 34.png|200px]]
Beneath the Roots of the Moving Tree |Along the eastern wall of the Deep Woods, the player can find a small [[Tree|pine tree]]. If the player captures the tree, they can move it out of the way to reveal a glowing spot on the floor. Mario must then ground pound the glowing spot to reveal a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !35 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 35.png|200px]]
Deep Woods Treasure Trap |Near the southern end of the Deep Woods, the player can find a Warp Pipe coming out of a large tree. Mario must enter the pipe to find a room with tree treasure chests. If the player opens them in the correct order (center, left, right), they will receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !36 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 36.png|200px]]
Exploring for Treasure |At the northern end of the Deep Woods (where the river's origin is located), the player can find a locked door being guarded by a Steam Gardener. In order to enter this door, the player needs to wear both the Explorer outfit and the Explorer hat. Once Mario enters the room, he can find a treasure chest in the center of the room. Opening it will reward the player with a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !37 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 37.png|200px]]
Wooded Kingdom Timer Challenge 1 |Next to the Iron Road: Halfway Point checkpoint, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some poles and a Power Moon above them. The player must then swing up the poles and collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !38 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 38.png|200px]]
Wooded Kingdom Timer Challenge 2 |At the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a scarecrow on the left-most charging station. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some platforms and a Power Moon above them. The player must then jump up the platforms and collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !39 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 39.png|200px]]
Flooding Pipeway |Near the Iron Road: Entrance, the player can find a pool of water with a submerged Warp Pipe. Mario should enter this Warp Pipe and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !40 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 40.png|200px]]
Flooding Pipeway Ceiling Secret |In the area with the "Flooding Pipeway" Power Moon, the player should look for an opening in the ceiling. Mario must enter this opening in order to find a small alcove with a hidden Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !41 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 41.png|200px]]
Wandering in the Fog |Near the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a Mini Rocket on an iron platform. Mario should capture the rocket to be taken to a secret area covered in fog, where he must find and collect five [[Moon Shard]]s. If he can collect them all, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !42 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 42.png|200px]]
Nut Hidden in the Fog |In the area with the "Wandering in the Fog" Power Moon, the player can find a nut hidden behind an iron platform on the northern side of the area. If Mario destroys this nut, he will receive a secret Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !43 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 43.png|200px]]
Flower Road Run |From the Summit Path checkpoint, the player should head to the back side of the large sloped ramp, where a hidden door can be found. Mario must enter this door and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !44 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 44.png|200px]]
Flower Road Reach |In the area with the "Flower Road Run" Power Moon, the player must capture a Goomba and then use it to create a Goomba Tower. This will allow Mario to reach the hidden Power Moon located on a high iron platform that he could otherwise not reach. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !45 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 45.png|200px]]
Elevator Escalation |At the Summit Path checkpoint, the player should locate a hidden door at the top-right side of the large sloped ramp. Mario should enter this door and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to find a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !46 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 46.png|200px]]
Elevator Blind Spot |In the area with the "Elevator Escalation" Power Moon, the player must capture a Sherm at the start of the area and then use it to shoot and destroy a hidden rock located on the back wall. This will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon. |- !47 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 47.png|200px]]
Walking on Clouds |Near the Secret Flower Field Entrance, the player can find a Steam Gardener that will give a seed once activated. Mario must then carry this seed to the large seed pot on the Observation Deck. This will take him to a secret area in the clouds. If the player reaches the end of this area, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !48 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 48.png|200px]]
Above the Clouds |In the area with the "Walking on Clouds" Power Moon, the player must capture an Uproot at the start of the area and use it to reach a hidden Power Moon located high above the platform in the center of the area. |Available after collecting the "Defend the Secret Flower Field!" Power Moon. |- !49 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 49.png|200px]]
Secret Path to the Steam Gardens! |This Power Moon can be found inside the Iron Cage. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: *If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom before the [[Lake Kingdom]] and visits the Snow Kingdom after the Seaside Kingdom, then the painting can be found on a high cliff ledge at the north end of the starting area in the [[Snow Kingdom]]. *If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom before the Lake Kingdom and visits the Seaside Kingdom after the Snow Kingdom, then the painting can be found inside the Crystal Palace at the center of the [[Seaside Kingdom]]. *If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom after the Lake Kingdom, then the painting can be found a ledge hidden directly behind the Odyssey in the [[Metro Kingdom]]. |Available after collecting the "The Bound Bowl Grand Prix" Power Moon (Snow Kingdom).

Available after collecting the "The Glass Is Half Full!" Power Moon (Seaside Kingdom).

Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon (Metro Kingdom). |- !50 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Wooded Moon 50.png|200px]]
Found with Wooded Kingdom Art |Near the Odyssey, the player should look for a picture of the Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Trace-Walking mini-game in the Sand Kingdom, along with two bushes north of his location. If the player then returns to the Sand Kingdom, locates these two bushes and ground pounds next to them, they will be rewarded with a hidden Power Moon. |Available from the start. |} {|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed navbox mario sm" !colspan=3|
